_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: Y changes by 0.5 per unit of LDL

agreement.claim: both engines report the same 2SLS estimate, robust and conventional SEs, first-stage F and OLS comparator
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/instrument_examples.test.py shows the two-stage OLS shortcut gives the same coefficient and an SE off by 28%, requires F above 100, and over 100 seeds OLS confounded upwards by more than 0.4.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance separates the effect from zero and from OLS (about 1.2). Measured by harness/instrument_examples.test.py, running python.py on seeds 0 to 99.
